items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Good morning, Monk.

ctx.x: Carmen was interviewed via Zoom on February 15, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very privileged to have Carmen Lundy with me this afternoon for me, and good morning to you.
